newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-BECKER HOPES TO PLAY IN STUTTGART OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER HOPES TO PLAY IN STUTTGART OPEN.

text.p: Australian Open champion Boris Becker hopes to play at the Stuttgart Open next week despite a recurring wrist injury, organisers said on Friday.
Becker, who tore a ligament in his right wrist during the third round at this year's Wimbledon, was forced to withdraw from the Czech Indoor Open on Thursday because of wrist problems.
But organisers of the Stuttgart tournament said they would put back Becker's opening match until Wednesday to give the German time to recover.
